General Skill Mechanics
When active skill levels are too far apart (more than 25 levels), abilities that are above the 25 level difference are grayed out on the skill bars and uavailable.
Skills and how to obtain them
The following table provides an overview of all the available skills currently available in the game, and some of their associated skill trainers. Information on learning a skill can be found on its individual page.

N/A
Gaming
Skill in playing games, especially gambling games.
???
Gender Studies
A careful exploration of gender roles and sexuality, focusing on Human, Elven, and Rakshasa cultures. This knowledge is not directly applicable to combat or crafting, but it helps you to be a well-rounded individual.
N/A
Genetics
Knowledge of the genetics of creatures in general. This is an umbrella skill that encompasses a vast suite of sub-skills for particular types of creatures. This skill represents generalized genetics knowledge.
None
Goblinese
Fluency in the language of the
goblins
.
Golf
Skill in golf-related games. Covers any game involving the propulsion of an object toward a designated goal on the landscape.
Pennoc
Gourmand
The art of appreciating what you eat. Every level of the Gourmand skill increases the duration of meal bonuses by 30 seconds. The main way to earn Gourmand XP is by eating foods you've never eaten before.
N/A
Hardcore Living
Skill in surviving as a Hardcore player. You earn XP in this skill by killing dangerous creatures while Hardcore. (The creatures' level must be higher than your Hardcore Living skill.) Note: if you stop being Hardcore, you will lose all levels in this skill.
Vughal
, Entity under Povus.
Holistic Wellness
An approach to health that involves taking into account factors beyond the obvious. Some critics claim that any benefits are due to the placebo effect, and they may be right. But if it works, who cares?
Lakrea
Hoplology
The study of weapons and armor, with a focus on the benefits and weaknesses of different kinds of equipment. As the skill increases, Staff users will find that their combat abilities also restore Armor.
N/A
Industry
Competence in completing tasks to specification. Highly industrious workers can juggle more tasks at once, and earn slightly higher rewards for their hard work.
Sheyna
Interpretive Dance
Skill in dancing to music in a way that entertains or moves others.
Lana Songtree
Iocaine Resistance
Practiced resistance to the deadly mushroom poison known as Iocaine. (Each point of this skill reduces the damage from Iocaine-based poisons by 1%.)
N/A
Lore
Mastery of ancient knowledge.
N/A

Skill in centering yourself and creating inner focus. This is especially helpful when using Unarmed combat skill.

Knowledge of the secret language of ancient fungus creatures.

Nature Appreciation
Finding inner peace through connection with flowers and nature.
Crelpin
Non-Ruminant Ungulate Genetics
Knowledge of the genetics of large herbivores that do NOT chew cud, such as pigs, rhinos, and horses. Also covers hippos, which are not ungulates, but which are close enough.
Notoriety
Oratory
The ability to speak in a public way that moves your audience.
N/A
Orcish
Fluency in Orcish, the ancient language of orcs -- as well as many other races and cultures.
Melandria
Paleontology
Studying the past through old fossilized bones. Infamous for its primary research method: necromantic reanimation. The higher your Paleontology skill, the more bones you are likely to find when excavating a site. Higher skill also gives chances to find fossils in the loot of some monsters.

Skill in surviving as a Hardcore player. You earn XP in this skill by killing dangerous creatures while Hardcore. (The creatures' level must be higher than your Hardcore Living skill.) Note: if you stop being Hardcore, you will lose all levels in this skill.

An approach to health that involves taking into account factors beyond the obvious. Some critics claim that any benefits are due to the placebo effect, and they may be right. But if it works, who cares?

The study of weapons and armor, with a focus on the benefits and weaknesses of different kinds of equipment. As the skill increases, Staff users will find that their combat abilities also restore Armor.
Competence in completing tasks to specification. Highly industrious workers can juggle more tasks at once, and earn slightly higher rewards for their hard work.
Skill in dancing to music in a way that entertains or moves others.
Practiced resistance to the deadly mushroom poison known as Iocaine. (Each point of this skill reduces the damage from Iocaine-based poisons by 1%.)
Skill in centering yourself and creating inner focus. This is especially helpful when using Unarmed combat skill.
Knowledge of the secret language of ancient fungus creatures.
Finding inner peace through connection with flowers and nature.
Knowledge of the genetics of large herbivores that do NOT chew cud, such as pigs, rhinos, and horses. Also covers hippos, which are not ungulates, but which are close enough.
The ability to speak in a public way that moves your audience.
Fluency in Orcish, the ancient language of orcs -- as well as many other races and cultures.

Studying the past through old fossilized bones. Infamous for its primary research method: necromantic reanimation. The higher your Paleontology skill, the more bones you are likely to find when excavating a site. Higher skill also gives chances to find fossils in the loot of some monsters.
Skill in figuring out how someone or something died. Higher skill allows more details to be determined and more difficult organisms to be examined.
Skill in performing with percussion instruments such as drums, bells, and dulcimers.
This umbrella skill represents your ability to entertain with performances of music, acrobatics, dance, art, recitals, and so on.
Skill in finding the meaning of poems, especially difficult and tedious ones.
Skill in riding terrestrial mounts. Higher skill allows you to keep your mount calm even in terrifying situations. Earn XP by riding in many different and dangerous locations.
Expertise in opening safes, vaults, and other physical barriers.
Skill in performing with stringed instruments such as harps, lutes, and guitars.
Skill in performing with brass and woodwind instruments such as trumpets, ocarinas, and flutes.
